flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery.note: New on 2026-10-17, one variable from the card-sampling configuration of the day; since the 2026-10-18 consolidation it is the oldest link the Strata chain has left, and the configuration the retired greedy, card-sampling and route-tail-skip ids name in their refusal: TOOL_CALL_RECOVERY=on. Pinned from the day it exists, so a later edit to either configuration moves a digest here rather than going unnoticed. Re-pinned on 2026-10-17 again for three variables this container is now told through and nothing else moved: --conversation-cache-mib and --conversation-cache-min-free-mib, both stating off here, and --ple-gguf stating off. Stating off is what tells the entry point to take the flags out of the run config it wrote on an earlier boot; the three lines are here so every configuration of this engine says what the workspace it shares is left holding. Re-pinned on 2026-10-18 for one number: context_tokens 163840 to 196608, the first rung of the session-size ladder in docs/deployment.md. Both configurations of this engine move on the same rung, which is what the one-variable rule is actually protecting -- the run config is one file per workspace, so two configurations of one resident that disagreed about the window would make a switch between them a resize, and a rung is the window and nothing else.

New on 2026-10-17, one variable from flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery: the conversation-cache budget moves from off to 16384 MiB, and with it the two refinements only an on cache has use for (--conversation-cache-slots 2, --conversation-cache-min-tokens 16384). This one does need the image this revision pins, because the flags go into the engine's run config and only this house's entry point can write there. Sized from this box's engine log; see the profile's own warning for what it buys and for the /metrics reading that says it is not buying it. Re-pinned with its sibling on 2026-10-18 for the same reason and on the same rung: the session window goes to 196608 in both, so the difference between the two stays the conversation-cache budget it was created for.
